answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 154940 Country: UAE Title: Auditor in a finance company Question: I work in a finance company as an auditor. Is my income Haram? Also I am desperately trying out for a job change and I am not getting despite trying. Please pray for me and let me know what is the best possible way to get it from Allah. Answer ID: 154940 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 15/29/L=1/1439) Your income cannot be termed as haram, you may use it. However, you should try to find out any other job and leave the present job when you get one. For getting job, offer nafl salah and pray Allah. May Allah fulfill your legitimate needs! Amen! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
